prompt: Which statements about the GIL are true?
explanation: The GIL hurts CPU-bound multithreading (only one thread runs bytecode at a time) but not I/O-bound threading.

options.text: It allows only one thread to execute Python bytecode at a time
Threads release the GIL while waiting on I/O, so threading still helps I/O-bound work
It has no impact on CPU-bound multithreaded performance
Python 3.13+ has an experimental free-threaded (no-GIL) build
